info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Lazurite Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the onboarding and management of Lazurite battery details within the product catalog. Developers can use this endpoint to submit comprehensive details of new Lazurite battery offerings, ensuring accurate representation in the inventory. Targeted primarily at inventory managers and product developers, it streamlines the process of catalog updates. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their product offerings and maintain up-to-date information for end-users.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for a Lazurite battery, enabling enhanced management and tracking of battery specifications and performance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Lazurite battery. It requires a JSON object that adheres to the specified schema, which defines the required properties and their formats. Ensure that all required fields are included in your submission.

CreateCatalogLazuriteBatteryDetailReques.title: Battery Operation Request

lazurite_battery_id.description: The unique identifier for the Lazurite battery.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person who requested the battery operation.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The unit price of the battery.

supplier.description: Details of the supplier providing the batteries.

CreateCatalogLazuriteBatteryDetailReques.description: Schema representing the request body for battery operation details including battery ID, requester information, quantity, priority flag, unit price, and supplier details.

Supplier.title: Supplier Details

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier is verified.

Supplier.description: Schema representing the supplier information including name, verification status, and contact details.

Contact.title: Contact Information

email.description: The email address for contacting the supplier.

phone.description: The phone number for contacting the supplier.

Contact.description: Schema representing contact information including email and phone number.

CreateCatalogLazuriteBatteryDetailRespon.title: Lazurite Battery Operation Response

status.description: The status of the operation performed.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record that was created or modified.

CreateCatalogLazuriteBatteryDetailRespon.description: Schema representing the response structure for a successful POST operation related to Lazurite battery details.

content-type.description: Indicates the media type of the response body. Typical values include `application/json` or `text/plain`. This header tells the client how to interpret the data returned.

x-processing-time.description: Represents the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. This can help clients understand the performance of the API.
